title: Discovery of 2-(isoxazol-5-yl)phenyl 3,4-dihydroxybenzoate as a potential inhibitor for the Wnt/beta-catenin pathway.
authors: Dong, Yongxi; Liu, Mingji; Mao, Yongqing; Wu, Shuxia; Wen, Jinlan; Lu, Jun; Yang, Yaxin; Ruan, Shiyang; Li, Lei; Liu, Xinyun; Zhang, Jiquan; Liao, Shanggao; Dong, Li
one_liner_zh: 该文研究小分子抑制剂靶向β-catenin/BCL9蛋白-蛋白相互作用，属于蛋白-蛋白互作而非蛋白-DNA互作，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Carnosic acid could disrupt the beta-catenin/BCL9 protein-protein interaction and inhibit beta-catenin dependent transcription, thereby reduce the incidence of colorectal cancer induced by abnormal activation of Wnt/beta-catenin signalling pathway. However, its activity was weak (IC(50) for SW480: 28.2 +/- 2.05 muM) and total synthesis was difficult. During the structural simplification of natural products, S0 was revealed to be the basic pharmacophore of carnosic acid. Subsequent structural optimization of S0 led to the discovery of S11 as a possible anticancer agent with prominent proliferation inhibition effect (IC(50) for SW480: 9.56 +/- 0.91 muM) and best selectivity index (SI = 3.0) against Wnt hyperactive cancer cells. Futher mechanism investigation through TOP/FOP dual luciferase reporter assay, immunofluorescence, co-immunoprecipitation, microscale thermophoresis, downstream oncoprotein expression and cell apoptosis showed that compound S11 could significantly inhibit the proliferation of SW480 cells via obvioudsly decreasing the nucleus translocation of beta-catenin and effectively disrupting beta-catenin/BCL9 protein-protein interaction. Additionally, cell migration, molecule docking, in vitro stability and solubility assays were also conducted. Overall, S11 was worthy of in-depth study as a potential inhibitor for the Wnt/beta-catenin pathway and its discovery also proved that the structural simplification of natural products was still one of the effective methods to find new lead compounds or candidate drugs.
abstract_zh: 鼠尾草酸能够破坏β-catenin/BCL9蛋白-蛋白相互作用并抑制β-catenin依赖性转录，从而降低由Wnt/β-catenin信号通路异常激活诱导的结直肠癌发生率。然而，其活性较弱（对SW480的IC(50)为28.2 ± 2.05 μM），且全合成困难。在天然产物的结构简化过程中，S0被揭示为鼠尾草酸的基本药效团。随后对S0的结构优化发现了S11，其作为一种可能的抗癌剂，具有显著的增殖抑制效果（对SW480的IC(50)为9.56 ± 0.91 μM），并对Wnt过度活跃的癌细胞具有最佳选择性指数（SI = 3.0）。通过TOP/FOP双荧光素酶报告基因实验、免疫荧光、共免疫沉淀、微量热泳动、下游癌蛋白表达及细胞凋亡的进一步机制研究表明，化合物S11能通过显著降低β-catenin的核转位并有效破坏β-catenin/BCL9蛋白-蛋白相互作用，从而明显抑制SW480细胞的增殖。此外，还进行了细胞迁移、分子对接、体外稳定性和溶解度实验。总体而言，S11作为Wnt/β-catenin通路的潜在抑制剂值得深入研究，其发现也证明了天然产物的结构简化仍是寻找新先导化合物或候选药物的有效方法之一。
